# Diego Bonmatí Salazar

> Neuroscientist based in Helsinki, Finland. Studies how people come to agree and how influence travels from individuals to conversations, groups and societies, using EEG hyperscanning (recording two brains at once). Also writes long-form essays on democratic theory, political polarisation and cognitive/informational manipulation.

## Current position
- Scientific and Regulatory Support, European Chemicals Agency (ECHA), Helsinki (2026–)

## Education
- MSc in Neuroscience, University of Helsinki (2023–2026). Thesis: "The Effect of Inter-Brain Synchrony on Reaching Agreement During Discussions of Emotionally Varied Topics", graded 5/5 (excellent)
- MSci in Biochemistry with Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, University of Bristol (2018–2022), Second Class Honours, First Division (2:1)
- European Baccalaureate, European School of Alicante (2016–2018)

## Research experience
- NeuroSchool Fellow, Institut de Neurosciences des Systèmes, Aix-Marseille Université (2025): inter-brain phase-locking (PLV) pipelines for face-to-face hyperscanning; muscle-artefact sensitivity of synchrony metrics
- Thesis Researcher, Faculty of Medicine, University of Helsinki (2025–2026)
- Research Assistant, Neuropharmacology Division, University of Helsinki (2024): inflammatory markers in neurodegeneration
- Research Assistant, Neuroscience Center, University of Helsinki (2024): KCC2 transporter in epilepsy
- MSci thesis, University of Bristol (2021–2022): antiviral nasal spray against SARS-CoV-2
- Summer Research Assistant, School of Chemistry, University of Bristol (2020): modular protein design for nanobody docking (Rosetta)

## Science for policy
- Translated neuroscience findings into guidance for parents, educators and policymakers (Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Helsinki, 2025)
- Trainee, International Affairs, University of Helsinki (2025): Nordic and North American partnerships
- Policy Assistant, School of Biochemistry, University of Bristol (2021–2022)

## Interests
Inter-brain synchrony, agreement and persuasion; polarisation; propaganda and information operations; cognitive warfare; Russia and Eastern Europe, the Nordic–Baltic region, the Middle East and North Africa.

## Languages
Spanish (native), English (C2), Finnish (B1), French (A2)
